blocks.title: About Us
blocks.text: We are renewable energy experts specializing in solar, battery systems, EV charging, and generator installation.

blocks.label: About Porter – Our mission
blocks.title: Your Local Renewable Energy
blocks.text: Our mission is to build the future of energy and infrastructure through integrity, craftsmanship, and innovation. We deliver high-performance electrical, solar, battery, and EV charging solutions that empower people, businesses, and communities to become more independent, resilient, and sustainable. By combining decades of hands-on expertise with forward-thinking technology, we help shape a world where energy is cleaner, smarter, and accessible to all.
